name: Transportation
description: From structural body-in-white components and powertrain housings to EV battery trays and motor casings, LK machines deliver the precision and throughput that automotive and commercial vehicle manufacturers depend on. High-pressure die casting and five-axis machining are the backbone of modern vehicle lightweighting.

name: Smart 3C & 5G
description: Ultra-thin aluminium and magnesium alloy housings for smartphones, tablets, laptops, and 5G base-station components demand micron-level dimensional accuracy and Class A surface finish. LK hot-chamber die casting and high-speed machining centres are certified for Apple-supply-chain quality standards.

name: Daily Necessities
description: High-volume, low-unit-cost production of consumer goods — from furniture hardware and lifestyle accessories to food-safe packaging components — requires machines that run three shifts without compromising dimensional consistency. LK injection moulding and automation lines deliver exactly that.

name: Industrial Supplies
description: Heavy-duty components for energy infrastructure, material handling, rail transit, and general engineering require machines built to the same exacting standards as the parts they produce. LK gantry machining centres and large-tonnage die casting machines handle ferrous and non-ferrous workpieces at scale.

name: Household Appliance
description: Compressor shells, motor housings, decorative trim, and structural enclosures for white goods and kitchen appliances require consistent wall thickness, excellent surface quality, and repeatable production cycle times. LK die casting and injection moulding machines serve every major appliance OEM in Asia.

name: Healthcare
description: Medical devices, diagnostic equipment housings, and single-use consumable components require cleanroom-compatible production, validated process control, and full material traceability. LK electric injection moulding machines (Elettrica series) and precision CNC centres are designed to meet these exacting standards.
